description: Dark blue-green patterned crossed-front long coat with broad brown-gold geometric edging, layered brown sleeves, ornate woven sash and leather belt with round metal medallions, loose brown trousers and dark brown boots. Restrained repeating knot and cloud motifs appear across the coat and borders. Both hands hang visibly at the sides; full head and boots have clear frame margins. No headgear, armor or weapon. The generously fitted waist and torso show substantial clothed fullness; exact fat and muscle values cannot be measured under the coat.
